root.testBehavior: REXTORA_STRATEGIES_DIR is mandatory and must not equal, contain, or be inside protected production strategy roots
root.rextoraDataDirBehavior: No effective behavior in strategyStore production root; productionStrategiesRootCanonical intentionally ignores REXTORA_DATA_DIR

behavior.list: Index order is preserved; invalid IDs and missing files are skipped; SAFE is validated and overlaid with activation flags from the index.
behavior.get: Validates the ID and returns the first matching list entry or undefined.
behavior.write: Pretty JSON via synchronous writeFileSync; index rewritten after mutations unless unchanged by indexStrategiesEqual.
behavior.delete: Only unlocked non-SAFE strategies inside ROOT may be synchronously unlinked; index is then rewritten.
behavior.missing: Missing store or SAFE causes ensureStrategyStore to seed SAFE and repair the index; missing requested ID returns undefined.
behavior.malformed: Malformed SAFE throws PROTECTED_STRATEGY_INTEGRITY; malformed index or ordinary rows may yield empty discovery/repair behavior as currently implemented.
behavior.duplicate: Existing promotion/idempotency semantics are unchanged; generated copy/custom IDs remain unique and duplicate promotion returns the existing record.
behavior.sorting: No additional sort is applied; index and readdir order are retained.
behavior.atomicity: Writes are synchronous direct writes, not temporary-file rename transactions.
behavior.errors: Native fs errors and StrategyValidationError behavior propagate exactly as before except where existing catch blocks intentionally return [] or repair the index.
behavior.userGeneratedData: Remains runtime JSON under ROOT and must not become a static application import.
